newsitem.title: USA: AVIC sets $10 mln flexible equity line.
newsitem.headline: AVIC sets $10 mln flexible equity line.

text.p: AVIC Group International Inc said Wednesday it has reached a flexible equity line agreement with Promethean Investment Group LLC which allows AVIC to access, at its sole option, up to $10 million through sales of its common stock.
This equity line has a two-year term, the company said.

As a result of this agreement, AVIC and its Chinese subsidiaries now have over $20 million in cash balances and financing lines available for expansion of existing projects, development of new projects and acquisitions, AVIC said.

Chief Financial Officer Michael Lim stated, "This is an extremely attractive financing vehicle for AVIC because it provides us additional flexibility to rapidly invest in our existing and future telecom joint ventures in China.

"The availability of these funds also strengthens our position as we evaluate possible strategic alliances with other telecom ventures in China and provides AVIC with working capital on an as-needed basis as our first projects begin producing revenues this year."
